close_reason: Fixed: transient DNS failures now return Err(DnsTxtInvalid) instead of Ok(None), so enforce_for_delivery's warn\! path fires correctly
description: mta_sts_dns.rs lines 28-33: the 'if matches!(e.kind(), NoRecordsFound { .. })' guard is dead code — both branches return Ok(None). DNS timeouts, SERVFAIL, REFUSED all produce Ok(None) rather than Err, so enforce_for_delivery's Err(e) warn! path is never reached for transient failures. On cache miss the delivery silently proceeds with no log. Intent was clearly to differentiate (the caller has a differentiated Err arm that warns). Fix: return Err(MtaStsError::DnsTxtInvalid or a new variant) for non-NXDOMAIN errors so the caller's warn! fires.
title: lookup_mta_sts_txt dead-code branch silently swallows transient DNS failures
